in_marathi.name: Shubash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shubash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bringing blessings and good fortune, indicative of success and prosperity. The name Shubash is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shubh’ which means auspicious or propitious. The name is a sign of God's grace and blessings, and is believed to bring prosperity and success to the bearer.
